tei:div.tei:p: (17)rig 'dzin bla ma bsgrub pa'i rim pa kun bzang don gyi phrin las zhes bya ba bzhugs so// (18)

rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag mchog rdul snyed rgyal dang rgyal sras ma lus pa'i// spro dang bsdu ba'i byed po khyod las su// dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// de la 'dir rig 'dzin bla ma sgrub pa kun bzang don gyi phrin las bzhungs srong ba'i rim pa rnams gzhir bzhag pa'i sgo nas 'jug pa la/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ hūm̐/ don dam spros bral chos sku'i ngang*// rang bzhin gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje'i sprul sku'i bla ma la// 'dzin med ngang nas skyabs su mchi// gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni/ ho// ye nas lhun rdzogs sangs rgyas chos// ma bcos thig le gcig tu 'khyil// rang gsal rig pa chos sku'i klong*// rang grol chen por sems bskyed do// gsum pa tshogs bsags pa ni/ ho/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal// dus gsum bzhugs la sogs nas byang chub chen por bsngo// bzhi pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ rje btsun nga ni rgyal ba kun gyi yab// thams cad ngar brjod (19)rig 'dzin yongs kyi rje// thams cad ngar 'dus rnal 'byor yongs kyi dpon// srid gsum char ltar babs kyang nga mi gsher// khams gsum chu ltar 'brug kyang nga mi khyer// rgyud drug me ltar 'bar kyang nga mi tshogs// stong gsum rlung ltar g.yos kyang nga mi bskyod// dug gsum mun ltar 'thibs kyang nga mi 'thibs// ye shes nyi ma shar yang gsal rgyu med// ma rig mun pa byung yang gnag rgyu med// skye shi ris su bcad kyang 'chi rgyu med// nyon mongs dug gsum gnas kyang spang rgyu med// dngos grub rnam gsum yin yang chags rgyu med// chos sku 'gyur med grub kyang rtsol ba med// rang byung nyid du gnas pas rag mi lus// snying po lhun gyis grub pa'i rten mi 'cha'// mtshams kyi rgyal po mi rtog ye gnas pas// bgegs kyi rgyal po rtog pa ma spang bcoms// a ma hā shu bya tya dzñā na yāḥ

lnga pa bshags pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med (20)pa la// gzung 'dzin gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin pa nyer re mongs// spros med bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi// kun tu bzang po bzang ngan med pa la// gtsang sme gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// bzang ngan gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// kun bzang bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi// mnyam pa nyid la che chung med pa la// bdag dang gzhan du lta ba thang re chad// che chung gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// mnyam nyid bde chen klong du bshags par bgyi// byang chub sems la skye 'chi med pa la// 'di dang phyi mar lta ba thang re chad// skye 'chi gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// 'chi me g.yung drung du bshags par bgyi// thig le chen pa grwa zur med pa la// gzugs dang rdzas su lta ba thang re chad// grwa zur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// kun nas zlum po'i thig le'i klong du bshags// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las// thog ma tha mar blta ba thang re chad// (21)'pho 'gyur gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// dus gsum 'gyur med klong du bshags par bgyi// rang byung ye shes rtsol ba med pa la// rgyu 'bras gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// rtsol sgrub gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// rang byung rtsol med ngang du bshags par bgyi// rig pa ye shes gzung 'dzin med pa la// rtag chad gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// rig pa ye shes klong du bshags par bgyi// chos dbyings rnam dag spros pa med pa la// rtag chad gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// mtha' dbus gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// chos dbyings rnam dag klong du bshags par bgyi// gzhal yas khang la yang dog med pa la// phyi dang nang du lta ba thang re chad// yangs dog gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// gzhal yas yang dog med pa'i klong du bshags// yum gyi mkha' la mtho dman med pa la// (22)stong dang 'og tu lta ba thang re chad// mtho dman gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// bha ga mtho dman med pa'i klong du bshags// chos kyi sku la gnyis su med pa la// phyi nang gnyis su lta ba thang re chad// snod bcud gnyis su 'dzin pa nyen re mongs// chos sku 'gyur med klong du bshags par bgyi// ma rig rmongs pa'i blo 'di snying re rje// gzugs med chos la dngos po mtshan mar 'dzin// gang zag 'khrul pa'i blo 'di yong re sdug

skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu bzung*// snang srid sgyu ma yin par ma shes pas// zang zing nor la sems kyis chags pa skyes// 'khor ba rang bzhin med par ma shes pas// gnyen bshes 'khrul pa'i grogs la rtag par bzung*// mi shes skye bo'i sems 'di yongs re gol// bden pa'i don bor mi dge'i las la brtson// ston pa'i bka' bor mi chos g.yeng bas bslus// rang rig daun bor g.yeng ba'i las la brtson// 'di 'dra'i don med (23)sems can snying re rje// dbye bri med pa'i klong du bshags par bgyi// drug pa dam bca' ni/ ho/ ye nas lha dang gnyis su med// rang byung rig pa kun tu bzang*// dgongs pa klong du ma gyur bar// srog gi phyir yang mi gtong ngo*// sa ma ya a la la ho// bdun pa byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐/ sku gsum rgyal ba 'dus pa'i pho brang nas// chos nyid rig pa don gyi ye shes lha// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma yi dam dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can las byed tshogs// khyed kyiu gas rjes thugs dam dus la babs// lhun grub gsang chen rol pa'i gzhal yas 'dir// ma 'gags rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis byin chen phob// rang byung sku dang thig le me re re// lhun grub 'ja' 'od zer phreng lam se lam// byin rlabs dngos grub na bun thu lu lu// rig 'dzin gdung 'tshob rnal 'byor bdag cag la// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs su byin phob cig gnas yul snang ba dag pa'i (24)ye shes rtsal// lhun grub sgyu 'phrul drwa ba byin gyis rlobs// oṃ gu ru sarba dzñā na a be sha ya hūm̐ ha a dzhai pheṃ pheṃ ja// brgyad pa mchod pa byin rlabs la/ hūm̐/ thams cad kun bzang rol pa'i rtsal// 'gags med snang ba'i cho 'phrul kun// phyi nang gsang ba de nyid kyis// mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐// dgu pa rten dang brten par bskyed pa ni/

hūm̐/ rang gi sems nyid gdod nas ma dag na// 'phral du phyogs tsam bsgom pas dag mi 'gyur// chos nyid ma bcos ye nas yin shes na// de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ma bsgom gsal// thabs kyi rtsa ba snying rje ma shar na// 'phral gyi phyogs tsam yongs la khyab mi 'gyur// brdal ba chen po blo yi spyir khyab na// kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ma bsgom gsal// rgyu nyid dag pa'i don nyid ma shes na// 'phral gyi dmigs pas rang rig gsal mi 'gyur// ye nas yin par rang rang rig gsal rtogs na// (25)rgyu yi ting 'dzin de yang ma bsgaum gsal// da lta'i sems nyid stong gsal rjen pa 'di// tha mal nyams kyi 'dzin stangs dag pa las// 'byung lnga rnam dag dwangs ma'i zhing khams su// rlung lnga rnam dag 'od lnga'i gzhal yas dbus// seng khri padma nyi zla'i gnad gyi stong*// sems nyid ma bcos rang byung 'od gsal ba// gzhir bzhengs kun bzang don gyi bla ma mchog mdo rgyud man ngag rgya mtsho'i shing rta che// chos rje bla ma dam pa bde bar gshegs// dmar smug nyams kyi lang tshos rnam par sgegs// zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje'i dkyil krung bzhugs// spyan zung dbyings la chos sku'i lta stangs mjad// srid gsum dus pa'i 'gro ba ngal bso'i phyir// phyag gnyis sems nyid ngal gso'i phyag rgya mjad// rab byung rdzogs pa paṇḍi ta yi chas// zhi 'jug mtshan dpe lang tshos rnam par mjes// stong gsal sgrib bral 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku// (26)snang la rang bzhin med par lhun gyis grub// thugs kar ye shes 'od lnga 'khrugs pa'i klong*// rang byung 'gags med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i lha// bcom ldan zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsal// spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su// chos sku zhi ba'i rang mdangs khro bo'i tshogs// 'jigs byed lnga bcu rtsa brgyad lhun gyis grub// lte bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i gzhal yas su// rgyal kun phrin las 'dus pa kī la ya// sras 'khor sprul pa 'khor dang bcas pa gsal// sku yi ba spu'i khong du re rer yang*// ma lus mi lus lus pa med pa yi// rgyal ba sras bcas nyan rang 'phags pa dang*// yi dam zhi dang khro bo'i lha tshogs kun// gsal la ma 'dres ye nas lhun rdzogs gsal// gnyis med bde chen bha ga ma rtogs na// 'phral du yum mchog bskyed pa'i sku mi rdzogs// shes rab pha rol phyin par dbyer med pas// snying rje yum mchog thabs dang shes rab rdzogs// phyi 'khor (27)'od lnga'i thig le'i 'khrigs pa'i klong*// sems klong man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// bka' sdod ye shes 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs// gsal stong dbyings las rang byung grub pa'i lha// gsal la ma 'dres ye nas lhun rdzogs gsal// sems kyi dbang phyug 'dod dgur ma shes na// 'phral du ye shes lnga yi dbang mi chags// kun gzhi'i rtsa ba phyogs bcur dbang bsgyur bas// yo 'byams chen pa'i dbang mchog ma bskur rdzogs// dgongs pa'i byin rlabs thig ler ma bslabs na// 'phral gyi dgongs pas sku gsung thugs mi brlobs// rang byung bde bas khams gsum byin brlabs pas// sku gsum byin rlabs cho 'phrul rang bzhin tshang*//

bcu pa dbyings nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'od gsal rin chen snying po'i dkyil 'khor nas// kun bzang rig 'dzin bla ma gshegs su gsaul// rang mdangs 'gags med lhun grub dkyil 'khor nas// zung 'jug (28)sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gshegs su gsol// rang shar rang grol chen po'i las byed tshogs// bka' nyan dam can rgya mtshau gshegs su gsol// e hya hi bha ga wan ma hā ka ru ṇi ka dri shya he sa ma ya ja ja// bcu gcig bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ sems nyid zung 'jug rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*// dkyil 'khor 'khor lor ye nas rang shar bas// dam ye dbyer med mnyam rdzogs chen po'i ngang*// bde chen 'du 'bral med par bzhugs su gsol// bcu gnyis pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ snang med stong med ngos bzung med la phyag 'tshal lo// dran med rig med 'gyur ba med la phyag 'tshal lo// byar med zhen med 'dzin pa med la phyag 'tshal lo// skye med lhun grub chos kyi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu gsum pa mchod pa ni/ hūm̐/ yid kyi mchod pas stong gsum ma khyab na// 'phral du phul bas rgyal ba mnyes mi 'gyur// yongs la khyab pa'i mnyes pa rgyun med na// mchod pa'i cho 'phrul don du ma sgom (29)tshang*// gzugs su snang ba dngos med mchod pa'i tshogs// sgra ru grags pa gzugs med mchod pa'i sprin// tri ru tshor ba dngos med mchod pa'i rgyan// ro ru myong ba tshor med mchod pa'i mchog reg byar dran pa 'dzin med mchod pa dang*// skye med blo 'das chos kyi mchod pa che// kun bzang rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// hūm̐/ bdag gi phung po khams dang skye mchod kun// chags med mchod pa'i sprin du rab sprul nas// chags pa med pa'i tshul gyis 'bul lags na// bcom ldan spyi dpal thugs rjes bzhes su gsaul// bcu bzhi pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas khyed kyi sku mchog ci 'dra ba// nam mkha'i dbyings la cir yang snang ba'i sku// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med chos kyi sku// 'dus byas 'dus ma byas pa thabs kyi sku// sku mchog kun bzang sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas khyed kyi gsung mchog ci (30)'dra ba// sgra snang brjod med don las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje 'dul phyir gsung mchog ci yang ston// brjod med gsung mchog shes rab pha rol phyin// gsung mchog kun bzang gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas khyed kyi thugs ni ci 'dra ba// rnam rtog mi mnga' cir yang sa ler mkhyen// ye shes spyan ldan thams cad 'dus ma byas// dran byed rig pa'i rgyal po yongs su shar// thugs mchog kun bzang thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod// sangs rgyas khyod kyi yon tan ci 'dra ba// che ba'i yon tan med las ci yang snang*// snang tsam nyid nas thig le'i ngang du 'dus// lhun rdzogs mtha' phyin rgyal ba'i yon tan sku// yon tan kun bzang lha la phyag 'tsha bstod// sangs rgyas khyed kyi phrin las ci 'dra ba// thabs kyi phrin las 'gro ba yongs la khyab// skye 'gro mang po thar ba'i lam la 'god// thabs mkhas mthar phyin rgyal ba'i phrin las sku// (31)phrin las kun tu bzang la phyag 'tshal bstod//

bco lnga pa bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ thugs kar 'od lnga'i thig le'i klong*// ye shes sems dpa' kun tu bzang*// mthing gsal mnyam bzhag phyag rgya can// de'i thugs kar nyi zla'i steng*// hūm̐/ yig mthing ga'i mtha' bskor du// sngags phreng lu gu rgyud du 'khor// 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba dang*// khyad par brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bskul// phyi nang snod bcud dag par sbyangs// byin rlabs dngos grub thob par bsam// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru pra dzñā song ha sarba siddhi hūm̐// zhes bzla zhing slar snying po don gyi 'jab ni/ hūm̐/ dgongs pa yid kyi ting 'dzin mi gsal na// 'phral gyi 'phro 'dus rig pa'i lha mi gsal// chos nyid rang gsal rig pa'i gting go na// ting nge 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul ma bsgom gsal// don gyi bsnyen pa kho nar ma shes na// 'phral du mtshan mar brjod pas 'grub pa med// yid kyi (32)bzlas brjod dus dang rgyun med na// rnal 'byor bsnyen pa'i cho ga yang dag rdzogs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dgongs pa'i rgyun bskyang ngo*// bcu drug pa tshogs kyi mchod pa ni/ ram̐ yam̐ kham̐/ tshogs kyi rgyan rnams bkram pa yang*// rang bzhin gnas pas 'grib pa med// lhun gyis gnas pas mi bsngo ste// gdod nas dag pa bdud rtsi yin// 'du byed bcu gnyis khyad par du// lhag pa'i bsam pas bzung du med// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis brlabs/ bcu bdun pa tshogs zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ rang rig mtha' dbus med pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rang byung ye shes gsal 'grib med pa'i sku// gdod ma'i mgon po dpal mgon bla ma la// 'khor du ye shes rgya mtshau'i tshogs dang bcas// snang srid gzhir bzhengs tshogs la gshegs su gsol// bco brgyad pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'khor 'das chos rnams blang dor bral ba'i tshul// snang srid ngo bzung med par 'bul lags na// nam mkha'i mtha' ltar kun tu thag pa med// chos sku (33)'gyur ba med pa'i klong na bzhugs// ma bcos thig le dur khrod gcig tu 'khyil// mi skyes mi 'gags klong du phrin las rdzogs//

bcu dgu pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐/ gzugs snang rab 'bring tha mal thams cad kun// sku mchog mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rdzogs// sgra grags rab 'bring tha ma thams cad kun// gsung mchog mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rdzogs// dran rtog rab 'bring tha ma thams cad kun// thugs mchog mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo rdzogs// sems nyid ma bcos de ny-id ma shes na// ji ltar brtags pas sdug bsngal nyid du gyur// lta ba kun tu bzang la mthol bshags nas// rnam rtog gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// sems nyid ma yengs don nyid ma shes na// ji ltar bsgom pas sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// ting 'dzin kun tu bzang la mthol bshags nas// rnam rtog gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// rang byung (34)lhun gyis grub par ma shes na// ji ltar btsal kyang sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// phrin las kun tu bzang la mthol bshags nas// srog dbugs gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsaul// phung po rgyal ba'i sku ru ma shes na// ji ltar bskyed pa sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// rang bzhin kun tu bzang la mthol bshags nas// rang byung gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsaul// gzung ma shes rab nyid du ma shes na// ji ltar spyad pas sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// dam tshig kun tu bzang la mthol bshags na// thig le gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// rang byung gdod nas dag par ma shes na// ji ltar sbyangs pa'i sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// rnam dag kun tu bzang la mthol bshags nas// sha khrag gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// longs spyod sgyu ma yin par ma shes na// ji ltar bsags pas sdug bsngal nyid du 'gyur// spyod pa kun tu bzang la mthol bshags (35)nas// yo byad gtor ma'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol// phyi nang snod bcud gtor mar bsdus nas ni// thugs rjes chen po'i gtor ma rab sprul te// ye shes gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul lags kyis// chos nyid dbyings kyi gtor ma bzhes su gsol// oṃ shri bha tra āḥ

nyi sha pa bsgral bstab ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni ye nas rang byung dpal chen po// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs he ru kas// ma rig rū tra ye shes mtshon chas bsgral// dug lnga bdag med rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyor// phung khams dwangs ma ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur// rang snang dbyer med chen por bzhes su gsol// nyer gcig pa lhag ma skyong ba ni/ pheṃ pheṃ/ ye shes dbyings las sgyu 'phrul rol pa'i gar// dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong ma sring mkha' 'gro'o tshogs// dam rdzas dpal gyi pha phab 'di bzhes la// rang grol gnyug ma don gyi phrin las mjod// nyer gnyis pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ (36)hūm̐/ sems nyid gnyug ma gzhon nu bum pa'i sku// nang gsal phra ba'i ye shes sgyu 'phrul las// kun mkhyen rig 'dzin bla ma'i thug dam bskul// khyed kyi rjes 'jug rnal 'byor bdag cag la// don dam rig pa rtsal gyi dbang chen bskur// byin brgyud dgongs pa'i drod chen snying la stsol// tha mal las rlung kun rtog 'khrul ba'i khams// gzhi grol kun bzang don gyi phrin las mjod// nyer gsum pa brtan maskyong ba ni/ hūm̐/ ma rig rten 'brel 'khor ba'i snang cha kun// chos nyid gdod ma'i dbyings su thim pa'i rtsal// bde chen sgyu ma'i gar mkhan brtan ma'i tshogs// zag med kun bzang don gyi gtor ma bzhes// khams gsum yongs grol chen po'i phrin las mjod// nyer bzhi pa rta bro ni// hūm̐/ sems nyid rang byung ye shes dkyil 'khor 'dir// gnyis 'dzin log 'dren dam sri 'byung po kun// mnan no ka dag don gyis rgyas gdab pas// nam (37)yang lhang med ye shes rolamo shar// nyer lnga pa dngos grub blang ba ni/ hūm̐/ mi gnas mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas// chos nyid ma bcos don gyi bla ma yis// gsang ba gsum dang mnyam sbyor dngos grub mchog da lta nyid du bdag la stsal du gsaul//

rtsa sngags mthar kā ya wakka tsitta sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐// nyer drug pa bshags pa ni/ ho/ gnyug ma'i rang zhal sgrib pa'i sgrib tshogs kun// rang grol mnyam pa chen por bshags bgyid na// bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med chen po'i ngang*// kun bzang rang rig bla ma'i rang zhal blta// nyer bdun pa bsdu ldang ni/ ā// lha snang phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du bsdu// ye nas mnyam rdzogs bsam brjod bral bar bzhag slar yang snang grag ye shes bla ma yi// gsang gsum mi zad rgyan gyi rol par shar// nyer brgyad pa bsngo ba ni/ chos nyid dngos po med pa'i ye stong (38)'di// lta ba 'di dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog chos nyid nyams myong med pa'i bde stong 'di// bsgom pa 'di dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog sems nyid 'chos pa med pa'i rang stong 'di// spyod pa 'di dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog chos nyid 'gyur ba med pa'i ye stong 'di// 'bras bu 'di dang mi 'bral 'grogs par shog nyer dgu pa bkra shis brjod pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid mkha' la thugs rje'i sprin phung 'khrigs// brgyud gsum rig 'dzin bla ma'i bkra shis shog dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen char 'beb pa// yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog lhun grub phrin las rnam bzhi'i glog phreng mjes// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi bkra shis shog skal ldan gdul bya'i 'bras bu smin mdzad pa'i// rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog dkyil 'khor sgrub (39)(40) mchod bstod dang bzlas pa kun// byin rlabs bla ma'i sgrub pa 'dir 'dus zhes// rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud las rab sngags 'di// rgyu mtshan yid la bzhag nas 'bad pas bris// 'on kyang 'phags min byis blo'i nongs pa yi// dri ma gang mchis bla ma sems pa dang*// gang rgyal khab chen por lhun grub shog ces pa'ang sgrub brtson dam pa chos dbyings kyis nan tan chen pos bskul ngor ma hā paṇḍi ta chen po si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba rje de'i bka' 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal ba mkhan ming ngag dbang dpal bzang gis bris pa dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
